# Hugging Face datasets source excerpts

The sampler implementation excerpts and diff in
`reports/implementation-audit-v1/sampler-source-*` come from Hugging Face
`datasets`, versions 4.8.5 and 5.1.0, under the Apache License 2.0.
The original license is included here. Upstream source links and comparison
methods are recorded in the audit report.

Source: https://github.com/huggingface/datasets
